title: Strict-system operation data before realization
statement: On each scheme use the actual coefficient sequence derived category, completed scalar source, canonical reconstruction calculus and exact inverse image [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core]. Direct retains the universal right-derived image of the ordinary sequence direct image, its adjunction and inverse factorization. DirectEvaluation fixes finite evaluations by both adjunction equations, the canonical scalar-restriction direct image, and adjacent quotient transitions [def-strict-coefficient-pullback-evaluation-data, lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. Open and OpenEvaluation similarly retain the exact ordinary open adjunction and its fixed evaluation mate [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Operations collects these data. Compositors and OpenComparisons retain the section-normalized pullback compositions, open base change, tensor and clopen adjunction transposes [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations]. These are definitions of strict-system data only; no construction of a completed, constructible or compact-support realization is asserted.
